source_semantics: Literal tolerance<=0 returns the identical input before any shape access or conversion, including nonarrays.
Positive path allocates chain bool and dists float64 from coords.shape[0], marks endpoints, then processes an explicit stack left-subchain first.
dr/dc/subtractions/projection/squares preserve source scalar and array dtype arithmetic and its overflow/promotion/warnings.
Perpendicular admission is BOTH strict projected lengths>0; other points use minimum endpoint Euclidean distance.
Perpendicular distances retain arctan2/sin/cos order; squared-distance or geometric-cross-product substitutions are not presumed exact.
Split uses any(distance>tolerance), then argmax over the entire distance slice, first occurrence tie and actual NaN behavior.
Final coords[chain,:] preserves input scalar words/dtype and actual advanced-index layout/type. Closed/repeated endpoints remain represented, and positive outputs need not share the identity route.
Protocols and callback mutations are observed in source order; no frontend coercion or worker policy is frozen here.

capture_protocol.authorization: Root must review this prospective packet before any original approximate_polygon invocation.
capture_protocol.journal: Exclusive journal per profile; flush started before each call and completed raw observation immediately after it. On observer failure preserve diagnostics and stop; never replay originals to repair metadata.
capture_protocol.verification: Check pinned source/signature/factory/observer and versions before target calls. Append saved observations and profile provenance only. Offline check all raw array blobs; never recapture.
capture_protocol.encoding: Exact dtype/descr/metadata/shape/strides/ownership/base/alignment and words for POD arrays; object values encoded semantically without pointer bytes. Preserve identity/sharing, warnings, source errors, callback events, all input/backing words and NumPy error policy/handler/buffer restoration. No longdouble or padded representations.

native_admission: Pending source-reviewed captures. Cases exercise full iterative RDP selection, not merely identity or Python surface. Native arithmetic partition and ABI will be chosen separately, with explicit provider boundaries where necessary.

capture_provenance.historical_fields: Initial status/capture_protocol describe the preserved prospective freeze and authorization requirement; this section records the authorized completed capture.
